# EvAvatarGroup

> A labelled, overlapping stack of avatars that share one size.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:avatar-group` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvAvatarGroup } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvAvatarGroup>` or `<ev-avatar-group>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/avatar-group/EvAvatarGroup.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-avatar-group">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvAvatarGroup>
  <EvAvatar label="AB" variant="blue" />
  <EvAvatar label="CD" variant="green" />
  <EvAvatar label="EF" variant="orange" />
  <EvAvatar label="+5" variant="number" />
</EvAvatarGroup>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvAvatar` (`evoq-ui:avatar`).

| `label` | `string` | — | no | Accessible name for the stack. |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Avatar**, frame `3715:14719` (Avatar). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to identify the author of a comment, message, post, or activity entry.
- Use in lists, tables, or cards to scan owner/assignee at a glance.
- Use letter variant (initials on colored bg) when no photo is available.
- Use number variant for grouped count indicators (e.g., “+3 more” in a stack).
- Use empty variant when identity is unknown but a placeholder slot is needed.
- Use error variant when an avatar fails to load or a user is invalid.

### When not to use

- Don't use for system/non-human entities  →  use Icon
- Don't use for status indicators alone  →  use Badge (`evoq-ui:badge`)
- Don't use as the only menu trigger  →  use Button (`evoq-ui:button`) as wrapper
- Don't use at sizes below 24px  →  use Icon (initials unreadable)

### Do

- Pick the avatar color deterministically from user id/initials so it stays stable
- Use the face-centered crop for image variant
- Use 1–2 uppercase letters for initials (“AB”)
- Add aria-label describing the user's name

### Don't

- Randomize avatar color on each render
- Use a non-square source image without cropping
- Use 3+ letters or lowercase initials
- Leave avatars unannounced for screen readers

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvAvatarGroup`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-avatar-group">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:avatar-group` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
